label: Alienware Aurora R15 gaming desktop
description: Gaming tower, 13th-gen Core i7/i9 with RTX 40 graphics, Killer 2.5GbE RJ45 and Killer Wi-Fi 6E.
notes: Killer E3100 2.5GbE RJ45 on the standard rear I/O (entry SKUs with the non-K CPU ship a 1GbE Realtek instead) - above-gigabit wired out of the box. Killer AX1675 Wi-Fi 6E included on most configurations, so the host can be dual-homed.
